description: Re-attestation of attest/item2.r11.json (kept as history) after issue #297 upsized the tx_cell select path (sel1b inverter nfin 3 -> 12, stage-1 mux transmission gates nfin 3 -> 5 in design/gen_cells.py) to close the a3 select-step delay at SS. layout/cells/tx_cell.gds was regenerated from the re-rendered netlist and the column re-assembled; the other three cells and the routed slice are byte-unchanged. Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs. Layout geometry only; DRC and LVS are separate records (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds the regenerated tx_cell stream; `--check` exits 0.

pad_check.note: Re-run against the re-assembled column (issue #297): 34/34 pads matched, the record is byte-identical (the sizing change does not move pads).

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte with the same seed (1), and `--check-input` confirms the tied netlist hashes to the report's provenance.input.content_hash. The digital netlist and the routed slice are byte-unchanged this pass (issue #297 touched only the drawn tx_cell).

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
